_comments.allow: Read-only inspection and non-destructive build/test commands run without prompting.
_comments.ask: Two classes sit here deliberately: (1) anything that moves history or dependencies, and (2) packages/authz and db/migrations - the two places where a silent mistake is most expensive, where one keystroke of confirmation is proportionate.
_comments.deny: Hard blocks. `docker compose down -v` is denied because it destroys the dev database volume - an easy and irreversible accident. `.mcp.json` is denied so MCP servers are only ever added by a deliberate human edit (see plan section 26).
_comments.hooks: Intentionally absent in Task 1. Hooks arrive in Task 2 with their scripts, so they can be tested the moment they are added rather than failing silently.
